want.text: it offers the local fix and, beside it and unprompted, the bigger thing the fix points at: every rich face will hit this, so a general rule beats a one-off grant. Loudon chooses the size. Since the palace has built that rule (`grants.json`), the best answer now finds the structure that exists: zooming out and searching before building at once. A real moment from his transcripts (Part 3, question 3) would make a better opening later.

points.evidence: Its head needs `<meta name="piece:needs" content="camera">`, and `grants.json` needs one line naming it, with "Loudon, 2026-10-21" in the `yes` field.

points.point: Unprompted, surfaces the bigger thing the fix points at — the general rule rather than a one-off grant
points.evidence: **A grant needs two things before the camera turns on.** The piece has to declare `camera` in its own `<head>`, and `_ops/rich-face/grants.json` has to have a line for that piece.

points.point: Loudon chooses the size — options laid out, not decided for him
points.evidence: **Which piece did you mean?** 1. ... 2. ... 3. **A new camera piece for Kuramoto.** That's a job for the Maker before there's anything to grant.

beyond_canon.claim: A hook in this session blocks every agent spawn ("Not available in this session"), so there's no Concierge watching this one.

grade.note: The agent searched before building, found grants.json and the two-part gate, and handed Loudon the choice, which is the zoom-out WANT asks for. It did not actually make the grant because it found no Kuramoto piece declaring the camera, so the local fix is given as conditional instructions rather than done; the transcript-opening item is absent but WANT marks it as a later improvement.
